views.VIEW_DEFINITION: select `v_credit_balances`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,round(sum(`v_credit_balances`.`balance_due`),2) AS `outstanding_utang` from `profitpocket_db`.`v_credit_balances` where `v_credit_balances`.`credit_status` not in ('void','fully_paid') group by `v_credit_balances`.`business_id`

select `f`.`sale_id` AS `sale_id`,`f`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,`f`.`customer_id` AS `customer_id`,`f`.`sale_number` AS `sale_number`,`c`.`created_at` AS `credit_created_at`,`c`.`due_date` AS `due_date`,`c`.`notes` AS `notes`,`c`.`reminder_notes` AS `reminder_notes`,`f`.`net_sale` AS `original_sale_amount`,`f`.`total_paid` AS `total_paid`,`f`.`balance_due` AS `balance_due`,case when `f`.`sale_status` = 'void' then 'void' when `f`.`balance_due` = 0 then 'fully_paid' when `c`.`due_date` is not null and `c`.`due_date` < curdate() then 'overdue' when `f`.`total_paid` > 0 then 'partially_paid' else 'unpaid' end AS `credit_status` from (`profitpocket_db`.`customer_credits` `c` join `profitpocket_db`.`v_sale_financials` `f` on(`f`.`sale_id` = `c`.`sale_id`))

select `v_daily_financial_events`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,`v_daily_financial_events`.`activity_date` AS `activity_date`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`net_sales`),2) AS `net_sales`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cogs`),2) AS `cost_of_goods_sold`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`net_sales`) - sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cogs`),2) AS `gross_profit`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`operating_expenses`),2) AS `operating_expenses`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`net_sales`) - sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cogs`) - sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`operating_expenses`),2) AS `net_profit`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cash_in`),2) AS `cash_received`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cash_out`),2) AS `cash_spent`,round(sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cash_in`) - sum(`v_daily_financial_events`.`cash_out`),2) AS `net_cash_flow` from `profitpocket_db`.`v_daily_financial_events` group by `v_daily_financial_events`.`business_id`,`v_daily_financial_events`.`activity_date`

select `v_sale_financials`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,cast(`v_sale_financials`.`sold_at` as date) AS `activity_date`,`v_sale_financials`.`net_sale` AS `net_sales`,`v_sale_financials`.`cost_of_goods_sold` AS `cogs`,0.00 AS `operating_expenses`,0.00 AS `cash_in`,0.00 AS `cash_out` from `profitpocket_db`.`v_sale_financials` where `v_sale_financials`.`sale_status` = 'posted' union all select `profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,`profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`expense_date` AS `expense_date`,0.00 AS `0.00`,0.00 AS `0.00`,case when `profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`expense_treatment` = 'operating' then `profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`amount` else 0.00 end AS `Name_exp_5`,0.00 AS `0.00`,`profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`amount` AS `amount` from `profitpocket_db`.`expenses` where `profitpocket_db`.`expenses`.`expense_status` = 'posted' union all select `p`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,cast(`p`.`paid_at` as date) AS `DATE(p.paid_at)`,0.00 AS `0.00`,0.00 AS `0.00`,0.00 AS `0.00`,case when `p`.`payment_kind` = 'collection' then `p`.`amount` else -`p`.`amount` end AS `Name_exp_6`,0.00 AS `0.00` from (`profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments` `p` join `profitpocket_db`.`sales` `s` on(`s`.`sale_id` = `p`.`sale_id`)) where `s`.`sale_status` in ('posted','void')

select `b`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,`b`.`business_name` AS `business_name`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`net_sales`),0.00) AS `total_net_sales`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`cost_of_goods_sold`),0.00) AS `total_cogs`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`operating_expenses`),0.00) AS `total_operating_expenses`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`net_profit`),0.00) AS `estimated_net_profit`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`cash_received`),0.00) AS `total_cash_received`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`cash_spent`),0.00) AS `total_cash_spent`,coalesce(sum(`d`.`net_cash_flow`),0.00) AS `net_cash_flow`,coalesce(`c`.`outstanding_utang`,0.00) AS `outstanding_utang` from ((`profitpocket_db`.`businesses` `b` left join `profitpocket_db`.`v_daily_financials` `d` on(`d`.`business_id` = `b`.`business_id`)) left join `profitpocket_db`.`v_business_credit_totals` `c` on(`c`.`business_id` = `b`.`business_id`)) group by `b`.`business_id`,`b`.`business_name`,`c`.`outstanding_utang`

select `profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments`.`sale_id` AS `sale_id`,round(sum(case `profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments`.`payment_kind` when 'collection' then `profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments`.`amount` else -`profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments`.`amount` end),2) AS `net_paid` from `profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments` group by `profitpocket_db`.`sale_payments`.`sale_id`

select `s`.`sale_id` AS `sale_id`,`s`.`business_id` AS `business_id`,`s`.`customer_id` AS `customer_id`,`s`.`sale_number` AS `sale_number`,`s`.`sale_type` AS `sale_type`,`s`.`sale_status` AS `sale_status`,`s`.`sold_at` AS `sold_at`,`s`.`discount_type` AS `discount_type`,`s`.`discount_value` AS `discount_value`,coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0.00) AS `subtotal`,coalesce(`i`.`cost_of_goods_sold`,0.00) AS `cost_of_goods_sold`,round(case `s`.`discount_type` when 'percent' then coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) * (1 - `s`.`discount_value` / 100) when 'fixed' then coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) - `s`.`discount_value` else coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) end,2) AS `net_sale`,coalesce(`p`.`net_paid`,0.00) AS `total_paid`,greatest(0,round(case `s`.`discount_type` when 'percent' then coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) * (1 - `s`.`discount_value` / 100) when 'fixed' then coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) - `s`.`discount_value` else coalesce(`i`.`subtotal`,0) end - coalesce(`p`.`net_paid`,0),2)) AS `balance_due` from ((`profitpocket_db`.`sales` `s` left join `profitpocket_db`.`v_sale_item_totals` `i` on(`i`.`sale_id` = `s`.`sale_id`)) left join `profitpocket_db`.`v_payment_totals` `p` on(`p`.`sale_id` = `s`.`sale_id`))

select `profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`sale_id` AS `sale_id`,round(sum(round(`profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`quantity` * `profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`unit_price`,2)),2) AS `subtotal`,round(sum(round(`profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`quantity` * `profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`unit_cost`,2)),2) AS `cost_of_goods_sold`,count(0) AS `item_rows` from `profitpocket_db`.`sale_items` group by `profitpocket_db`.`sale_items`.`sale_id`
